metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by Javi Pazos — advisory board, terraform upgrade, and more

plugins.name: advisory-board
plugins.description: An advisory board of five thinkers — Sinek, Sutherland, Pink, Kahneman, and Stoic philosophy — for reflection, decision-making, and persuasion

plugins.name: negotiate
plugins.description: Evidence-based negotiation assistant for written negotiations — salary, contracts, vendor terms, stakeholder influence

plugins.name: engineering-board
plugins.description: An engineering board of four software engineers — Kent Beck, Martin Fowler, Robert C. Martin and Dave Farley — who each review a design, plan or engineering decision in their own voice, and keep their disagreements visible

plugins.name: what-i-need-from-you
plugins.description: Ends every response that leaves the user something to answer or do with a highlighted "What I need from you" block, so pending questions and actions don't get lost in long responses

plugins.name: like-an-expert
plugins.description: Two agents that work the way the best practitioner in a field would: one researches a single question from the raw material and tests its assumptions, the other steps back from the task and returns every reframing and option without discarding any

plugins.name: wild-design
plugins.description: Designs new interfaces from a random word seed so they move off the model's most predictable choices, then deepens them with a design critic that judges screenshots alone and finishes them with the impeccable skill
